539:t_002:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems they planned to give us a warm welcome from the start.」

539:t_002:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Party poppers full of bullets and shells! We're some VIPs!」

539:t_002:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, are you sure about this?」

539:t_002:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I originally intended to ask for their cooperation against the $$新地球皇国$$, but that seems impossible in this situation.」

539:t_002:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return fire. But avoid unnecessary casualties.」

539:t_003:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I am going in. I need covering fire.」

539:t_003:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never expected to hear you ask for help.」

539:t_003:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$キリコ$$! Your $$ドッグ$$ is a special version, rebuilt with the best parts we could find!」

539:t_003:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm looking forward to your one-man army show!」

539:t_003:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Go, $$キリコ$$. We will clear the way.」

539:t_003:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I will watch your back. You just keep looking ahead.」

539:t_003:9.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Why!? Why does everyone try to help such an unfriendly man!」

539:t_003:11.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Admit it. $$キリコ$$ is different from you.」

539:t_003:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ doesn't talk much, but he's a good guy! Everyone knows that!」

539:t_003:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's odd coming from a former member, but compared to a guy who joined $$ファイヤバグ$$ willingly, he's in a whole other bare-ass league.」

539:t_003:14.en:
$$アル$$
「Is not the correct form of that idiom 'in a whole other league'?」

539:t_003:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Leave correcting his mistakes for later.」

539:t_003:17.en:
$$キリコ$$
「The entry point is over there.」

539:t_004:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「So your target is the cathedral.」

539:t_004:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I understand. I will eliminate the enemies approaching you first.」

539:t_004:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I won't let you go, $$キリコ$$! I'll crush you even if it costs me my life!」

539:t_005:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Be careful! Something is coming from near the cathedral!」

539:t_006:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's the one $$テイタニア$$ piloted!」

539:t_006:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「That is an $$オーデルバックラー$$... the unit given to the 13th rank, '$$秩序の盾$$'.」

539:t_006:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「That means whoever is piloting it is...」

539:t_006:5.en:
$$ネクスタント$$
「Martial prowess is the harmony of all things. Battle is peace.」

539:t_006:6.en:
$$ネクスタント$$
「All things are born of battle, come into being, and change.」

539:t_006:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「So they are already under the auxiliary brain's control.」

539:t_006:10.en:
$$キリコ$$
「The one behind them is a god...」

539:t_006:13.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「He ruled $$アストラギウス$$ from the shadows. His true form was a collective of people with special powers banished from Planet $$クエント$$...」

539:t_006:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So he is $$マーティアル$$'s god...!」

539:t_006:18.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「It has been a long time, $$キリコ$$. My apologies for not greeting you during the $$赫い霍乱$$ at $$アレギウム$$.」

539:t_006:20.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「...You will know the answer when you reach the cathedral.」

539:t_006:21.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Fine. If $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ intends to haunt me again, I will destroy him.」

539:t_006:22.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「I look forward to your struggle, $$キリコ$$. The $$ネクスタント$$s guarding the cathedral are super soldiers beyond $$ＰＳ$$s.」

539:t_006:23.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Even you cannot avoid a difficult fight.」

539:t_006:24.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Be careful, $$キリコ$$! $$ネクスタント$$s controlled by auxiliary brains are emotionless killing machines!」

539:t_006:25.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...I have no intention of obeying anyone.」

539:t_006:27.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Wait for me, $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.)

539:t_007:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Go, $$キリコ$$! I will defend this place to the death!」

539:t_007:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$テイタニア$$.」

539:t_008:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(He is counting on me...)

539:t_008:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(With those words, I... can go on living forever...)

539:t_009:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I will not let you through!」

539:t_009:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「You're being reckless, $$テイタニア$$!」

539:t_009:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm coming! Hold out until I get there!」

539:t_009:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I told $$キリコ$$ I would defend this place to the death! I stake my life on it!」

539:t_012:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$ will be here soon too.」

539:t_012:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Stay alert! Something else is coming!」

539:t_013:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「It's a fleet of land battleships!」

539:t_013:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$'s will dwells within them.」

539:t_013:2.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「So it is like what happened on Planet $$クエント$$.」

539:t_014:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Sorry. I was delayed looking for a usable $$ＡＴ$$.」

539:t_014:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I moved $$フィアナ$$ somewhere safe. There is no need to worry.」
